name: Finmap.keys_replace
script:
have h_main : ¬ (∀ {α : Type u} {β : α → Type v} [inst : DecidableEq α] (a : α) (b : β a) (s : Finmap β),   (Finmap.replace a b s).keys = s.keys) := by
  intro h
  have h₁ := h (α := PUnit) (β := fun _ => PUnit)
    (a := P.unit)
    (b := 0)
    (s := Finmap.singleton P.unit (1 : PUnit))
  simp [Finset.ext_iff] at h₁
  <;>
  (try contradiction) <;>
  (try aesop) <;>
  (try {
    have h₂ := h₁ (a := P.unit)
    simp at h₂
    <;> aesop
  }) <;>
  (try {
    have h₂ := h₁ (a := P.unit)
    simp [Finset.ext_iff] at h₂
    <;> aesop
  })
exact h_main

name: CategoryTheory.Limits.prod.diag_map
script:
have h_main : ¬ (∀ {C : Type u} [inst : CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y)   [inst_1 : CategoryTheory.Limits.HasBinaryProduct X X] [inst_2 : CategoryTheory.Limits.HasBinaryProduct Y Y],   CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (CategoryTheory.Limits.diag X) (CategoryTheory.Limits.prod.map f f) =     CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f (CategoryTheory.Limits.diag Y)) := by
  intro h
  -- We will show that the assumption leads to a contradiction.
  have h₁ := h (C := Set) (X := ℕ) (Y := ℕ) (f := fun x => x)
  have h₂ : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (CategoryTheory.Limits.diag (ℕ : Type u)) (CategoryTheory.Limits.prod.map (fun x : ℕ => x) (fun x : ℕ => x)) = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (fun x : ℕ => x) (CategoryTheory.Limits.diag (ℕ : Type u)) := by
    simpa using h₁
  -- Simplify the equation to find a contradiction.
  have h₃ := congr_fun h₂ 0
  have h₄ := congr_fun h₂ 1
  have h₅ := congr_fun h₂ 2
  norm_num [Function.funext_iff, CategoryTheory.Limits.diag] at h₃ h₄ h₅ <;>
    (try contradiction) <;>
    (try simp_all [Set.ext_iff]) <;>
    (try aesop)
  <;>
  (try
    {
      exfalso
      aesop
    })
exact h_main

name: List.minimum_ne_top_of_length_pos
script:
have h_main : ∃ (α : Type u_1) [inst : LinearOrder α] (l : List α), 0 < l.length ∧ l.minimum = ⊤ := by
  use ℕ, inferInstance, [0]
  constructor
  · -- Prove that the length of the list is positive
    simp
  · -- Prove that the minimum of the list is ⊤
    simp [List.minimum_cons, Option.some_inj]
    <;> decide

intro h
obtain ⟨α, inst, l, h₁, h₂⟩ := h_main
have h₃ : l.minimum ≠ ⊤ := h (α := α) (l := l) h₁
exact h₃ h₂
